limitations: Single continuation seed and reused original Dev; no independent effectiveness gain or replay-only causal effect is established.
The original retail exact loss uses only five fully observed periods crossed with seven generated financial scenarios.
Financial documents and manager replies are controlled/generated and do not establish real organizational effectiveness.
Final public-document and economic metrics follow parent restoration. The rejected language candidates have field-level Dev evaluations only.
Checkpoint write cadence/storage and concurrent CPU work differ; elapsed times are not a controlled speed comparison.
All full checkpoints and optimizer state are preserved locally with hashes. Public small policy weights still require the unpublished full parent; end-to-end external reproduction is not complete.
